text: In accordance with By-law 1-2018 to Govern the proceedings of the Board of Directors of CreateTO, regular meetings of the Board are determined by the Board and a schedule of those meetings shall be publicly available by the first meeting of the Board in each calendar year. City Council on November 25 and 26, 2020 approved the 2021 schedule of meetings for City Council and its Committees. The schedule of meetings for CreateTO has been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid meetings on days of cultural or religious significance. The following meetings of the Board of Directors of CreateTO have been scheduled for the remainder of 2021: Monday, March 8 at 9:30 a.m. Tuesday, May 11 at 9:30 a.m. Wednesday, July 7 at 9:30 a.m. Monday, September 13 at 1:30 p.m. Tuesday, November 2 at 9:30 a.m. Friday, December 10 at 9:30…
